description:
Pass gate execution the selected worktree's head from the git module, instead of having it start git in the checker's working directory.

## Background

- `execute_gate_checker_with_context` (`crates/jit/src/gate_execution.rs:90-187`) calls `get_git_commit` (`crates/jit/src/gate_execution.rs:551-565`) and `get_git_branch` (`crates/jit/src/gate_execution.rs:567-582`): two processes per exec gate run, each naming the literal `git` and running in `working_dir`.
- `working_dir` is the worktree root or the checker's declared subdirectory (`execute_captured_gate`, `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:1303-1343`). A declared subdirectory that is a separate git repository supplies that repository's head. With in-memory storage the working directory is the process directory (`checker_repo_root`, `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:668-674`), so evidence comes from whichever repository the process runs in.
- The evidence lands in `GateRunResult.commit` and `.branch` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:995`, `:998`).
- Callers of the entry point: `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:1324` and the unit tests in `crates/jit/src/gate_execution.rs`'s test module. `test_execute_gate_checker_records_head_commit` (`crates/jit/src/gate_execution.rs:1112-1131`) compares the recorded commit with `get_git_commit`, and `test_git_context_graceful_degradation` (`crates/jit/src/gate_execution.rs:720-729`) probes both helpers directly.
- Kept as one change for a build reason: `get_git_commit` and `get_git_branch` are private, and uncalled private functions fail the zero-warning build.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `execute_gate_checker_with_context` takes the run's head evidence as an argument and starts no git process. `get_git_commit` and `get_git_branch` no longer exist, and `gate_execution.rs` names no git executable.
- [hard] REQ-02: The executor passes the head of `require_worktree_paths()?.git()`, so a run records the selected worktree's commit and branch label whatever the checker's working directory; a store without a git checkout records neither.
- [hard] REQ-03: Two tests assert the behaviour change and fail on today's code. An exec gate whose declared working directory is a separate nested git repository records the selected worktree's commit, where today it records the nested repository's. An exec gate run on in-memory storage, with a git repository as the directory it would otherwise read (passed explicitly; the test does not change the process directory), records no commit, where today it records the process directory's.
- [hard] REQ-04: Every caller of the entry point, unit tests included, passes evidence. `test_execute_gate_checker_records_head_commit` asserts that the evidence passed in is the evidence recorded, and `test_git_context_graceful_degradation` is removed because the module owns lookup failures.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: gate evidence always describes the selected worktree, and in-memory runs carry none.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Gate runs take commit and branch evidence from the module
